plain.li: [seat:Physician] {HOLDER_nameDef}, the colony's {OFFICE}, has come up from the sickbeds to be heard on it. The sick are {HOLDER_possessive} business, {HOLDER_pronoun} says, and {HOLDER_pronoun} would rather be asked than told.

[seat:Physician] {HOLDER_nameDef} has had a say in this already, at length and with {HOLDER_possessive} sleeves still rolled up. As {OFFICE}, {HOLDER_pronoun} will be the one living with whatever the council decides.
[seat:Reeve] {HOLDER_nameDef}, as {OFFICE}, has an opinion on it, and has brought a handful of soil to the table to make it with.
[seat:Reeve] The fields are the {OFFICE}'s, and {HOLDER_nameDef} would like that remembered, and has asked to speak before anyone else does.
[seat:Herdmaster] {HOLDER_nameDef} has come in from the pens to be heard, smelling of them. The animals are the {OFFICE}'s to look after, and {HOLDER_pronoun} knows each of them by name.
[seat:Herdmaster] As {OFFICE}, {HOLDER_nameDef} would like a word first, having a fair idea what the animals can stand and what they can't.

[seat:Peacemaker] {HOLDER_nameDef}, the {OFFICE}, has been asked about it so often today that {HOLDER_pronoun} has started answering before the question is finished, and would like the council to hear {HOLDER_objective} out too.
[seat:Peacemaker] Quarrels are the {OFFICE}'s work, and {HOLDER_nameDef} has been in the middle of this one from the start, and has asked to be heard before anything is settled.
[seat:Keeper] {HOLDER_nameDef}, as {OFFICE}, has the day written down already, and would like the council's word on it before anyone else's.
[seat:Keeper] The {OFFICE}, {HOLDER_nameDef}, remembers how the colony kept it before, and has offered to tell the council, whether or not it asks.

[seat:Chaplain] {HOLDER_nameDef}, the colony's {OFFICE}, has asked to speak on it. Matters of the faith fall to {HOLDER_objective}, {HOLDER_pronoun} says, and {HOLDER_pronoun} has been thinking about little else.
[seat:Chaplain] As {OFFICE}, {HOLDER_nameDef} would like a word before the council decides, with the faith's view of it and {HOLDER_possessive} own.
[seat:Warden] {HOLDER_nameDef}, as {OFFICE}, has asked to be heard first. Strangers are {HOLDER_possessive} business, and {HOLDER_pronoun} has already had a long look at these.
[seat:Warden] The {OFFICE}, {HOLDER_nameDef}, has a view on it, and has been trying to give it to anyone who would stand still.
[seat:Quartermaster] {HOLDER_nameDef}, as {OFFICE}, has asked to be heard, and has brought the count of the stores along in case anyone wants to argue with it.
[seat:Quartermaster] Whatever the council decides comes out of the stores, says {HOLDER_nameDef}, and as {OFFICE} {HOLDER_pronoun} would like a say before it does.
{HOLDER_nameDef}, as {OFFICE}, has asked to be heard on it before the council decides, since the work is {HOLDER_possessive}.
I keep asking the council for things and nobody ever comes back to me about them.
It feels like the council only ever listens to the same three people.
I'm tired of hearing what was decided after it was already decided.
Nobody asked me before, so thank you for asking now.
I just wanted someone on the council to know how it looks from where I stand.

warm.li: Thank you for sitting with me, it helps to say it out loud to someone.

blunt.li: The council doesn't listen, and that's the whole of it.

gloomy.li: I don't expect anything to change, but I'm glad somebody asked.

cold.li: I have said what I came to say, and I would like it remembered.

cheerful.li: Well, that's more listening than I've had all season, so thank you.

plain.li: That's fair, and I'm sorry nobody sat down with you sooner.
I didn't know it had got that bad, thank you for telling me straight.
You're right that we should have asked you, and I'll remember it.
I've heard you, {OTHER_nameDef}, and I'm glad you said it.

warm.li: Come and find me whenever it gets like that again, I mean it.

cold.li: Noted, and I will keep it in mind.

plain.li: {OTHER_nameDef} sat with me for an hour today and listened to all of it. I still don't think much of the council, but I think a bit better of {OTHER_objective}.
The speaker came and found me today to hear what I had to say. I said it. It's a start.
{OTHER_nameDef} asked me what was wrong and then let me talk. Nobody on the council has done that before.

gloomy.li: {OTHER_nameDef} heard me out. Nothing will come of it, but it was decent of {OTHER_objective}.

blunt.li: Told {OTHER_nameDef} what I think of the council. The speaker listened. Good.

plain.li: [short:medicine] The medicine shelf is lower than I'd like.
[short:medicine] We'll want more medicine before somebody really needs it.
[short:food] There's less food in the stores than I'd like going into the next weeks.
[short:food] The food won't last as long as people think it will.
[short:meals] There aren't many cooked meals put by, somebody should get a pot on.
[short:meals] We're short of cooked meals, the cooks need to catch up.
[tribal,short:food] The store pits are emptier than they should be at this time of year.
[spacer,short:medicine] Medical supplies are under the reserve level.
There's blight in the {CROP}, I've marked it for cutting.
Blight on the {CROP} again, it all has to come out before it spreads.
I've marked the sick {CROP} for cutting, the rest looks clean.
Black spots on the {CROP}, so that row comes out before it spreads.
[lowtech] Blight in the {CROP}, those stalks come out today before it spreads.

blunt.li: Blight in the {CROP}, marked it, it comes out today.

gloomy.li: Blight in the {CROP}, and I'd hoped we'd seen the last of it.

plain.li: Anything moving out past the tree line, {OTHER_nameDef}?
Keep your eyes on the far side tonight, that's where they came from last time.
Shout the moment you see anything, don't wait to be sure.
Stay sharp, {OTHER_nameDef}, they might try again tonight.

warm.li: Get some warm food in you when you come off, {OTHER_nameDef}.

plain.li: [speaker] I made you a promise at the election, and you're owed an account of how it's going.
[speaker] I won't pretend it's going well, but I haven't given up on it.
[speaker] If anyone at this table has a better idea, I'm listening.
[speaker] Here is what went wrong, as far as I can tell.
[speaker] I'd rather you heard it from me than from anyone else.
[speaker] There's still time before the vote, and I mean to use it.
[decree] I've asked the council for {WHAT}, and I'd like the room to hear why.
[decree] Before we all go, I'm still asking for {WHAT}.
[repeal] I've asked the council to lift {WHAT}, and I'm asking again in front of everyone.
[repeal] {WHAT} has gone on long enough, and I'd like it lifted.
[wish] We've asked for {WHAT}, and I'd like to know who else wants it.
[wish] There's still the matter of {WHAT}, which some of us have been asking for.
[decree] {OTHER_nameDef} couldn't be here, so I'll read out the petition for {WHAT}.
[repeal] {OTHER_nameDef} couldn't be here, but asked me to read out the petition to lift {WHAT}.
[wish] {OTHER_nameDef} isn't here, so I'll read out the petition for {WHAT} myself.
[decree] {OTHER_nameDef} asked for {WHAT} and can't be with us, so here it is.
[repeal] On behalf of {OTHER_nameDef}, who isn't here: the petition to lift {WHAT}.
[wish] {OTHER_nameDef} and the others who signed want {WHAT}, and asked me to say so.
Aye, I'm with {OTHER_nameDef} on that.
Aye, and it's about time somebody said it.
[wish] Aye, I'd want the same.
[repeal] Aye, lift it.
[decree] Aye, I'd be glad of it.
Aye, put me down for it.
No, I don't see the need for it.
[decree] No, I'd rather we did without {WHAT}.
[repeal] No, leave it as it is.
[wish] No, there are better things to spend on.
No, not now, there are bigger worries.
[repeal] No, it's doing what it was meant to.
